title: Dext Review (2026)
intro: Dext is evaluated here as a payroll and benefits administration platform — Dext (formerly Receipt Bank) automates receipt and invoice capture for accountants and small businesses — mobile capture, email forwarding, and sync to Xero, QuickBooks, and Sage. Published tiered pricing (2026-08-19 — confirm on dext.com/pricing). Finance/bookkeeping adjacent — not payroll processing or core HRIS. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Dext when bookkeeping document capture is the job.
verdict: Choose Dext when bookkeeping document capture is the job. Compare Jibble for time tracking; Gusto for payroll. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.
